item.title: @fermatslibrary: In this week’s annotated paper: researchers measured plastic in human brain tissue from au…
item.dc:creator: @fermatslibrary
item.description:
Fermat's Library @fermatslibrary

In this week’s annotated paper: researchers measured plastic in human brain tissue from autopsies. The median brain in 2024 contained ~4.9 mg of plastic per gram of tissue, roughly the mass of a plastic spoon.

That’s ~50% more than in 2016 samples, and 7–30× more than in liver or kidney.

item.dc:creator: @fermatslibrary
item.description:
Fermat's Library @fermatslibrary

Today is a mathematical date we won't see again for 78 years.

10/24/26
10² + 24² = 26²

It's called a Pythagorean Triple Day. There are infinitely many Pythagorean triples, but only 12 dates this century satisfy the equation.Today is the last.

Next one: March 4, 2105. pic.x.com/qXZARoKv9m
